E1.label: Evasion: S3 without round amounts
E1.rule: As S3 on a simulated bakery (from India v Pakistan, Super 4, 21 Sep), but stakes are irregular (never multiples of 100).

E2.label: Evasion: betting split across 10 small fronts
E2.rule: Ten small fronts (~15 bets per match each) share syndicate B's bettors; three share a device ID with each other.

E3.expected_text: Weaker signal; still flagged by timing + graph, or marked 'would need consented bank data'
E3.label: Evasion: winners paid off-platform
E3.rule: As S3 on a simulated bakery (from India v Sri Lanka, 26 Sep), but no refunds or payouts on PayU.

S0.label: Hero bakery, normal months (real data)
S0.rule: No injection. The real Bread Basket stream for all 162 days, with simulated payer IDs.

S1.expected_text: No L2+; delta reserve holds Rs 0
S1.label: Diwali: every bakery and sweet shop x4-5
S1.rule: Festival multipliers from data/events/festivals.csv apply to all bakeries and sweet shops; Diwali evening x4.5. Gift-box purchases add round amounts and city-wide walk-ins.

S2.label: Sports bar busy on every match night
S2.rule: Match-window demand x2.6 with local payers; no payouts.

S3.expected_text: Flag within hours of T (<= 1 match day); L3 delta reserve; evidence pack
S3.label: Hero bakery taken over on day T
S3.rule: From T (2025-09-14, India v Pakistan), betting on every fixture: ~70% of the day's payments inside match windows; round stakes Rs 500/1,000/2,000; bettors from across the region (syndicate A) who repeat within minutes; winners paid back as 'refunds' to earlier payers.

S4.expected_text: Flag before the betting share passes 20% (design parameter)
S4.label: Slow ramp: betting share +3 points a week
S4.rule: From T, betting share of payments on match days rises 3 percentage points a week (week 1: 3%, week 2: 6%, ...).

S5.expected_text: Flag on day one via the graph engine
S5.label: Brand-new 'IT services' shell
S5.rule: Onboarded 2025-10-14, two days after BF2 was banned. 12 of its first 20 payers come from BF2's 2,000 bettors; shares a device ID with BF2.
